# Adopt an Animal (Ukraine)

> A joint humanitarian adoption project by Notpfote Animal Rescue e.V. and Vet Crew providing rescued dogs and cats from Ukraine with loving forever homes across Europe.

## Main Pages

- [Home Page](https://adoptananimal.github.io/adoptananimal/): Browse rescued animals looking for a home with detailed profiles, photo galleries, and adoption statuses.
- [Adopt Dogs](https://adoptananimal.github.io/adoptananimal/adopt/dog): Dogs and puppies rescued in Ukraine ready for international adoption.
- [Adopt Cats](https://adoptananimal.github.io/adoptananimal/adopt/cat): Cats and kittens rescued from conflict zones and shelters.
- [Adoption Process](https://adoptananimal.github.io/adoptananimal/process): Step-by-step guidance on how the international adoption workflow operates.
- [Partners & Shelters](https://adoptananimal.github.io/adoptananimal/partners): Partner animal shelters, veterinarians, and volunteer organizations in Ukraine.
- [About Us & Contacts](https://adoptananimal.github.io/adoptananimal/about): Mission statement, legal background, and direct contact details.

## Key Features

- Multilingual support (English, German, Ukrainian, Dutch).
- Comprehensive medical and behavioral profiles for all rescued animals (vaccination status, age, compatibility with other pets and kids).
- Transparent adoption process handled by certified European animal rescue organizations (Notpfote Animal Rescue e.V. & Vet Crew).
- Search and filter capabilities by animal type, age group, size, and location.

## Additional Resources

- [Sitemap](https://adoptananimal.github.io/adoptananimal/sitemap.xml): XML index of all public routes and animal profiles.
